title: Exact local obstructions around rank-47 4x4 matrix-multiplication schemes

canonical_inputs.description: Two frozen normalized rank-47 decompositions of the 4x4 matrix-multiplication tensor over F2

claims.statement: Neither frozen binary rank-47 scheme admits a coefficient-wise lift to Z/4Z that reduces to the same scheme modulo 2 and satisfies all 4096 matrix-multiplication tensor equations.
claims.verification: Exact F2 linearization with frozen XOR contradiction certificates, independently replayed by two implementations and deterministically regenerated.

claims.statement: For either frozen seed, neither the frozen factor-entry support nor any support obtained by one or two distinct factor-entry toggles admits an assignment of nonzero F3 coefficients satisfying the matrix-multiplication tensor equations.
claims.verification: Exact necessary sign-parity certificates for the base and every single toggle, plus complete independent Python and C++20 sweeps of all 2,543,640 unordered distance-two supports per seed; every pair is certified by a preserved contradiction or fresh exact global parity elimination, with zero survivors required in both implementations.

non_claims: No global tensor-rank lower bound of 48 over F3, Q, R, or C.
No exclusion of rank-47 F3 schemes at factor-entry support distance at least three from the frozen seeds.
No exclusion of other rank-47 F2 seeds with different lifting behavior.
No claim that consistency of the necessary F3 parity system would imply existence of an F3 decomposition.
No claim of independent specialist or peer review; review status remains pending.
ai_origin: Frontier-AI-generated Unsolved Labs research release; correctness claims rest on the public proof and exact artifacts, not on conventional human authorship.
